doctrine.root_rule: Tools do not organize the OS. The OS organizes the tools.
doctrine.surface_rule: Every host, tool, runtime, provider, domain, tunnel, and app is a surface or membrane, not the whole system.
doctrine.authority_chain: Operator decides. AETHER resolves. AETHIEAOPSYS proves. AEUSB authorizes. AEXHD carries. AEVPS persists. Cloudflare routes. Git seals. vRAG retrieves.

vRAG.role: maps/indexes/retrieves receipts, configs, routes, endpoint audits, domain bindings, services, topology

AETHER.role: binds continuity and resolves the active corpus root by signature

AEUSB.rule: AEUSB wakes. It is observed, not forced.

AEXHD_AE320.rule: AEXHD works. It extends, not owns.

WSL2_RUBIII.role: launcher, CLI executor, callable materialization, git/cloudflared/OpenSSH control

AEVPS_AVPS.rule: AEVPS hosts, persists, indexes, and routes. It does not own corpus authority.

Cloudflare.role: DNS, tunnel, Zero Trust, edge routing
Cloudflare.rule: Cloudflare routes. Cloudflare does not own the corpus body.

AENET_AETHERNET.role: network/routing membrane connected to thematriculation.cc and AETHIEA namespaces

Git_GitHub.rule: Git seals receipts and public-safe route material. Private keys remain excluded.

surfaces.ChatGPT_Library: external evidence reservoir/retrieval surface, not corpus body
